The size of each EthCtrlConfigEgressQueue shall be calculated in bytes by considering the following formula: size of one EthCtrlCon- figEgressQueue = EthCtrlConfigEgressQueueBufTotal * EthCtrlConfigEgressQueue- BufLenByte.
